[size=5][u][color=#f1c232][b]Clear Up Space On Your Farm With New Pocket Rooms![/b][/color][/u][/size]
[size=2]Need more space on your farm? Clear out some of those clumsy sheds and warp directly to fancy new ones with your Return Scepter![/size]

[size=2]It's like a bag of holding but for your beer and jam![/size]

[size=2]Reach out into the void to summon a magical room where you can do all your brewing and crafting without clogging up the space on your farm. Now you can fill up your farm with all kinds of beautiful designs and give those cows a little more space to roam![/size]


[u][color=#f1c232][size=5][b]How Does It Work?[/b][/size][/color][/u]
[size=2]1) Use GMCM or a text editor to change the config settings for Warp Network to allow using the return scepter and the menu by changing “MenuEnabled” and “AccessFromWand” to “true”.
[/size][size=2]
2) Purchase a mystical key from Krobus in the sewers.

3) Return to your farm and be greeted by a tinny event that informs you of your new voidstepping powers!

4) Use the Return Scepter to warp directly into fancy new sheds and greenhouses![/size]


[size=5][u][color=#f1c232][b]Config Options[/b][/color][/u][/size]
Use GMCM or the config.json inside Mods\Pocket Rooms\[CP] Pocket Rooms. Remember that all configs in SDV do not appear until after you open the game after installing the mod for which you wish to change the config. However I have included the config in the download for ease of naming. It's already there!

[u][color=#f1c232][size=5][b]Windows Install:[/b][/size][/color][/u]
1)[/b] [/color]Download, install, or update Stardew Valley.

[color=#f1c232][b]2)[/b] [/color]Download, install, or update [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url]. (Look on YouTube or [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI_on_Windows]here on the wiki[/url]﻿ if you can't figure out how to install SMAPI on Windows)

[b][color=#f1c232]3)[/color][/b] Download, install, or update [u][b]all the other requirements[/b][/u] under the "Requirements" tab above.﻿

[color=#f1c232][b]4)[/b] [/color]Download this mod, then extract it.[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]5)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]Move the extracted folder into your "SteamLibrary \ steamapps \ common \ Stardew Valley \ Mods" folder so that the final file structure looks like this:
﻿"SteamLibrary \ steamapps \ common \ Stardew Valley \ Mods \ Pocket Rooms - Mystic Sheds, Cellars  & Greenhouses"[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]6)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]That's it you're done, enjoy! (Ask in comments or PM me if you have any issues...)[/size]

[size=2][color=#f1c232][b]

[b][color=#f1c232]3)[/color][/b] Download, install, or update [u][b]all the other requirements[/b][/u] under the "Requirements" tab above.﻿

Downloads.Description:
Download all requirements and then Place in Stardew Valley\Mods folder

Check the changelog for changes...

Need more space on your farm? Clear out some of those clumsy sheds and warp directly to fancy new ones with your Return Scepter!

Downloads.FileName: Pocket Rooms - Allows Changing Wallpaper and Floors-13983-1-0-0-1664957246.zip
Downloads.Description:
Download the main file first then drag and drop this (extracted) into your mods folder.

Allows changing the wallpaper and the floor using Aedenthorn's Custom Decoration Areas. You need to download Custom Decoration Areas for this to work.
